title: Overview of the TREC 2021 Fair Ranking Track

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the exposure of Wikipedia articles associated with different geographic locations (continents) in search result rankings and comparing it to an ideal target exposure distribution (derived from the empirical distribution of relevant documents and world population) using Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF) and Expected Exposure metrics.

Evaluating the exposure of biographical Wikipedia articles categorized by the subject's gender in search result rankings and comparing it to a target equality distribution using Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF) and Expected Exposure metrics.

Calculating the combined exposure of intersectional groups (Geography × Gender) in result rankings and comparing it against a target probability distribution that averages known-group documents with global intersectional population statistics.
